steps.title: Lenses
steps.how: Demon Eyes drop them at night on the surface.

steps.title: Suspicious Looking Eye
steps.how: Craft at a Demon or Crimson Altar from 6 Lenses and use it at night. The Eye of Cthulhu can also show up on its own. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Desert Scourge Sigil.

steps.title: Iron Bars
steps.how: Smelt 3 Iron Ore each at a Furnace. Either this or Lead Bars is enough for your first armor.

steps.title: Lead Bars
steps.how: Smelt 3 Lead Ore each at a Furnace. Either this or Iron Bars is enough for your first armor.

steps.title: Iron Armor
steps.how: Craft the Iron Helmet, Chainmail and Greaves at an Iron or Lead Anvil.

steps.title: Lead Armor
steps.how: Craft the Lead Helmet, Chainmail and Greaves at an Iron or Lead Anvil.

steps.title: Wulfrum Metal Scrap
steps.how: Dropped by Wulfrum robots (Drones, Gyrators, Hovercraft) on the surface during the day.

steps.title: Wulfrum Prosthesis
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from 10 Wulfrum Metal Scrap. An early magic weapon for the Eye.

steps.title: Wulfrum Knife
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from 10 Wulfrum Metal Scrap. An early rogue weapon for the Eye.

steps.title: Marnite Repulsion Shield
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from Granite and Marble blocks, found in their underground cave biomes.

steps.title: Solidifier
steps.how: Always dropped by King Slime. Needed for Statigel armor and lets you craft Wormwood (2 Wood + 5 Gel).

steps.title: Wulfrum Armor
steps.how: Craft each piece at an Anvil from Wulfrum Metal Scrap and an Energy Core, dropped by Wulfrum robots (Drones, Gyrators, Amplifiers) on the surface.

steps.title: Snow Ruffian Armor (Rogue)
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from Boreal Wood, Silk and Flinx Fur.

steps.title: Fragments of Nature
steps.how: Any enemy in the Forest or Jungle has a 1/35 chance to drop 1-2.

steps.title: Fragments of Earth
steps.how: Any enemy in the Pyramid, Desert or Underground has a 1/35 chance to drop 1-2.

steps.title: Fragments of Tide
steps.how: Any enemy at the Beach or in the Dungeon has a 1/35 chance to drop 1-2.

steps.title: Fragments of Otherworld
steps.how: Any enemy in the Sky or a Meteor biome has a 1/35 chance to drop 1-2; Planetarium enemies drop them more often. Each Aerialite Bar needs one.

steps.title: Stormlion Mandibles
steps.how: Dropped by Stormlions in the Desert. Used for the Desert Medallion and SotS Cursed armor.

steps.title: Sulphuric Scales
steps.how: Dropped by Acid Rain enemies in the Sulphurous Sea. Used for SotS Nature armor.

steps.title: Frigid Bars
steps.how: Craft 2 at an Anvil from 10 Frigid Ice, 1 Ancient Steel Bar and 1 Fragment of Permafrost (cold-biome enemy drop). Daedalus armor in Hardmode also needs these.

steps.title: Frigid Armor
steps.how: Craft each piece at an Anvil from Frigid Bars (8 / 16 / 12).

steps.title: Vibrant Bars
steps.how: Craft 2 at a Furnace from 10 Vibrant Ore, 2 Glowing Mushrooms, 1 Iron/Lead Bar, 1 Fragment of Earth and 1 Wulfrum Metal Scrap (pack addition). Vibrant Ore is a worldgen crystal ore.

steps.title: Vibrant Armor (Ranged)
steps.how: Craft each piece at an Anvil from Vibrant Bars (10 / 12 / 10).

steps.title: Desert Medallion
steps.how: Craft at a Demon/Crimson Altar from 40 Sand, 4 Antlion Mandibles, 2 Stormlion Mandibles and 3 Fragments of Earth (pack addition). Reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Glowmoth Sigil.

steps.title: Pearl Shards
steps.how: The Desert Scourge drops 25-30. Combine 2 with Coral, Starfish and Seashells at a Furnace for Sea Remains.

steps.title: Victide Armor (Melee)
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from Sea Remains (3 / 5 / 4); the breastplate and greaves also need 4 / 3 Fragments of Tide (pack addition).

steps.title: Prism Shards
steps.how: Break Sea Prism crystals in the Sunken Sea, or kill Sunken Sea enemies such as the Blinded Angler.

steps.title: Suspicious Looking Candle
steps.how: Craft at a Demon/Crimson Altar from a Candle, 5 Glow Nylon (Cobweb + Glowing Mushroom at a Loom), 10 Glowing Mushrooms and 3 Prism Shards (pack addition). Use in a Glowing Mushroom biome; consumed. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 King Slime Sigil.

steps.title: Decapodita Sprout
steps.how: Craft at a Demon/Crimson Altar from 50 Glowing Mushrooms and 3 Fragments of Nature (pack addition). Reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Eye of Cthulhu Sigil.

steps.title: Fungal Clump
steps.how: Found in Crabulon's Treasure Bag (Expert/Master only).

steps.title: Aerialite Ore
steps.how: The first Hive Mind or Perforators kill enchants the Aerialite ore in sky-island clouds; mine it with a 65%+ pickaxe.

steps.title: Aerialite Bars
steps.how: Smelt at a Furnace from 3 Aerialite Ore plus 1 Fragment of Otherworld (pack addition).

steps.title: Aerospec Armor (Rogue)
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from Aerialite Bars (10 / 20 / 15) and Feathers.

steps.title: Peanuts
steps.how: Treasure Slimes drop 10-20; also from Peanut Bushes and pots in the Abandoned Village.

steps.title: Jar of Peanuts
steps.how: Craft by hand from a Bottle, 15 Peanuts and 2 Aerialite Bars (pack addition). Summons Putrid Pinky; consumed. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Queen Bee Sigil.

steps.title: Wormwood
steps.how: Putrid Pinky drops 20-30. It can also be crafted (2 per 2 Wood + 5 Gel) at a Solidifier, so this does not strictly require Pinky.

steps.title: Nature Armor (Summoner)
steps.how: Craft at a Work Bench from Wormwood and Fragments of Nature, plus 3 / 4 / 3 Sulphuric Scales (pack addition).

steps.title: Blighted Gel
steps.how: Ebonian/Crimulan Blight Slimes in the Corruption/Crimson drop 15-21 each.

steps.title: Overloaded Sludge
steps.how: Craft at a Demon/Crimson Altar from 40 Blighted Gel, 40 evil blocks and 5 Wormwood (pack addition). Reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Deerclops Sigil.

steps.title: Purified Gel
steps.how: The Slime God drops 30-45.

steps.title: Statigel Armor (Magic)
steps.how: Craft at a Solidifier from Purified Gel and Blighted Gel; the chest and greaves also need 6 / 5 Wormwood (pack addition).

steps.title: Abeemination
steps.how: Craft at a Demon/Crimson Altar from honey, hive and Stinger materials, or just break a Bee Larva in the Underground Jungle. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Hive Mind Sigil or Perforator Sigil.

steps.title: Bee Wax
steps.how: Dropped by Queen Bee.

steps.title: Cursed Matter
steps.how: Pharaoh's Curse drops it (14-24 in its bag); right-click the Pyramid sarcophagus to summon it. Ghasts in the Pyramid also drop some.

steps.title: Cursed Armor (Magic)
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil: hood from 8 Cursed Matter + 20 Royal Ruby Shards, robe from 12 Cursed Matter + a gem robe + a Ruby Keystone; 2 / 3 Stormlion Mandibles each (pack addition).

steps.title: Hellforge
steps.how: Find one in the ruined houses of the Underworld. Needed to smelt Hellstone Bars.

steps.title: Hellstone Bars
steps.how: Smelt Hellstone (needs a Nightmare/Deathbringer Pickaxe) and Obsidian at a Hellforge. The Eye of Desolation needs 10 in Hardmode. Required for Chapter 2.

steps.title: Molten Armor
steps.how: Craft each piece at an Anvil from Hellstone Bars.

steps.title: Guide Voodoo Doll
steps.how: Dropped by Voodoo Demons in the Underworld. Throw it into lava there to summon the Wall of Flesh.

steps.title: Earthen Plating
steps.how: The Excavator (summoned from the Seismic Station in the Abandoned Village) and Earthen Gizmos drop it. One kind of elemental plating for the Electromagnetic Lure.

steps.title: Hardlight Fabricator
steps.how: Craft by hand from 10 Avaritian Plating harvested in the Planetarium. Crafting station for SotS alloys and Twilight Assassin armor.

steps.title: Starlight Alloy
steps.how: Craft at the Hardlight Fabricator from a Fallen Star, a Fragment of Otherworld, a Twilight Shard and an Aerialite Bar (pack addition).

steps.title: Twilight Assassin Armor
steps.how: Craft at the Hardlight Fabricator from Starlight/Hardlight/Otherworldly Alloys (chest: Hellstone Bars + Hardlight Alloy) and a Dissolving Aether each, plus 4 / 6 / 5 Purified Gel (pack addition).

steps.title: Deer Thing
steps.how: Craft at a Demon/Crimson Altar from Flinx Fur, a Lens and Demonite/Crimtane Ore; use in the Snow biome. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Skeletron Sigil.

steps.title: Fleshbound Effigy
steps.how: Craft at a Demon or Crimson Altar from a Guide Voodoo Doll plus an Eye of Cthulhu, World Evil, Skeletron and Advisor Sigil. Throw it into Underworld lava. Until the Wall of Flesh falls, a plain Guide Voodoo Doll won't summon it.

steps.title: Souls of Light
steps.how: Dropped by enemies in the underground Hallow.

steps.title: Souls of Night
steps.how: Dropped by enemies in the underground Corruption/Crimson.

steps.title: Mythril Anvil
steps.how: Craft from 10 Mythril Bars at an Anvil. Needed for the mechanical boss summons and most Hardmode modded gear.

steps.title: Orichalcum Anvil
steps.how: Craft from 12 Orichalcum Bars at an Anvil. Equivalent to the Mythril Anvil.

steps.title: Mechanical Worm
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Rotten Chunks/Vertebrae, Iron/Lead Bars and Souls of Night. Use at night. Either a Mythril or an Orichalcum Anvil works. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Brimstone Elemental Sigil.

steps.title: Mechanical Eye
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Lenses, Iron/Lead Bars and Souls of Light. Use at night. Either a Mythril or an Orichalcum Anvil works. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Destroyer Sigil.

steps.title: Mechanical Skull
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Bones, Iron/Lead Bars and Souls of Light and Night. Use at night. Either a Mythril or an Orichalcum Anvil works. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Twins Sigil.

steps.title: Souls of Might
steps.how: Dropped by The Destroyer.

steps.title: Souls of Sight
steps.how: Dropped by The Twins.

steps.title: Souls of Fright
steps.how: Dropped by Skeletron Prime.

steps.title: Hallowed Bars
steps.how: Every mechanical boss drops Hallowed Bars. Absolute Bars need one each.

steps.title: Hallowed Armor (Melee)
steps.how: Craft each piece at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Hallowed Bars.

steps.title: Essence of Eleum
steps.how: Hardmode Snow enemies drop it: Ice Elementals, Icy Mermen, Wolves and Ice Tortoises always drop one.

steps.title: Fragments of Permafrost
steps.how: Any enemy in a cold biome has a 1/35 chance to drop 1-2; Arctic Goblins drop 1-2. Used by the Cryo Key, Cryonic Bars and the Ornate Shield.

steps.title: Cryo Key
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from 50 ice blocks, 5 Souls of Light, 5 Souls of Night, 8 Essence of Eleum and 6 Fragments of Permafrost (pack addition). Use in the Snow biome. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Queen Slime Sigil.

steps.title: Cryonic Ore
steps.how: Cryogen's first kill seeds Cryonic Ore through the Snow biome (180% pickaxe); Cryo Slimes also drop it.

steps.title: Adamantite Forge
steps.how: Craft from a Hellforge and 30 Adamantite Ore at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil. Smelts most Calamity and SotS Hardmode bars.

steps.title: Titanium Forge
steps.how: Craft from a Hellforge and 30 Titanium Ore at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil. Equivalent to the Adamantite Forge.

steps.title: Cryonic Bars
steps.how: Smelt at an Adamantite/Titanium Forge from 4 Cryonic Ore plus 1 Fragment of Permafrost (pack addition).

steps.title: Daedalus Armor (Ranged)
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Cryonic Bars; the breastplate and leggings also need 6 / 4 SotS Frigid Bars (pack addition, from Pre-Hardmode).

steps.title: Ornate Shield
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 12 Cryonic Bars, 20 Crystal Shards and 6 Fragments of Permafrost (pack addition).

steps.title: Dissolving Aurora
steps.how: Dropped by the Permafrost Spirit, which emerges when you kill a Permafrost Construct in the Snow biome.

steps.title: Frosted Key
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from a Dissolving Aurora, 8 Cryonic Bars (replacing the Frost Core in this pack) and a Soul of Might, Sight and Fright. Hold it and right-click the Frost Artifact in the Permafrost biome; not consumed. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Skeletron Prime Sigil.

steps.title: Souls of Plight
steps.how: Polaris drops them (25-40 in its bag). Needed for Absolute Bars and the Eye of Desolation.

steps.title: Absolute Bars
steps.how: Smelt at an Adamantite/Titanium Forge from 1 Hallowed Bar, 1 Soul of Plight and 1 Essence of Eleum (pack addition). Life Alloy needs these later.

steps.title: Frost Artifact Armor
steps.how: Upgrade Frost armor at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil with Absolute Bars (12 / 20 / 16) and Cryonic Bars (4 / 6 / 5, pack addition).

steps.title: Essence of Havoc
steps.how: Dropped by Hardmode Brimstone Crag enemies (Heat Spirits, Infernal Congealments, Soul Slurpers, etc.); Red Devils drop it 50% of the time.

steps.title: Eye of Desolation
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from 10 Hellstone Bars, 5 Essence of Havoc and 3 Souls of Plight (pack addition, so Polaris comes first). Use at night; reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Polaris Sigil.

steps.title: Ashes of Calamity
steps.how: The Calamitas Clone drops 25-30. Needed for Core of Calamity and, much later, to summon Supreme Calamitas.

steps.title: Unholy Cores
steps.how: Craft at a Hellforge from 3 Infernal Suevite (dropped by Infernal Congealments) and 2 Hellstone. (Hellforge from Pre-Hardmode.)

steps.title: Charred Idol
steps.how: Craft at a Hellforge from 5 Unholy Cores, 7 Essence of Havoc, 5 Souls of Night and 5 Fragments of Inferno (pack addition). Use in the Brimstone Crags. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Aquatic Scourge Sigil.

steps.title: Brimflame Armor (Magic)
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Unholy Cores and Ashes of Calamity.

steps.title: Seafood
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from 20 Sulphurous Sand, 10 Starfish, 5 Shark Fins and 5 Fragments of Tide (pack addition). Use in the Sulphurous Sea. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Cryogen Sigil.

steps.title: Gelatin Crystal
steps.how: Mine one from the crystal clusters in the underground Hallow; use it in the Hallow to summon Queen Slime. Bereft: someone nearby must carry Wall of Flesh Sigil when it's used, or the boss won't wake.

steps.title: Living Shards
steps.how: Plantera drops 30-40 (in its Treasure Bag on Expert+). Used for the reusable Portabulb and many Calamity items.

steps.title: Perennial Ore
steps.how: Plantera's first kill seeds Perennial Ore in underground dirt and stone (200% pickaxe); Perennial Slimes drop it too.

steps.title: Perennial Bars
steps.how: Smelt at an Adamantite/Titanium Forge from 4 Perennial Ore plus 1 Fragment of Nature (pack addition).

steps.title: Reaver Armor (Tank)
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Perennial Bars.

steps.title: Ectoplasm
steps.how: Dropped by Dungeon Spirits after Plantera. Needed for the Catalyst Bomb, Core of Calamity and Spectre Bars.

steps.title: Spectre Armor (Magic)
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Spectre Bars (Chlorophyte Bars + Ectoplasm).

steps.title: Essence of Sunlight
steps.how: Hardmode sky enemies drop it: Harpies and Angry Nimbi 50%, Wyverns 8-10. Used for Phase Bars (pack addition) and Core of Calamity.

steps.title: Core of Calamity
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from one each of Essence of Sunlight/Havoc/Eleum, Ashes of Calamity, Ectoplasm and Soul of Plight (pack addition).

steps.title: Asgard's Valor
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from an Ornate Shield, 5 Hallowed Bars, a Core of Calamity and 4 Absolute Bars (pack addition).

steps.title: Lihzahrd Power Cell
steps.how: Found in Jungle Temple chests (the Temple Key comes from Plantera). Place it on the Lihzahrd Altar. Bereft: someone nearby must carry Astrum Aureus Sigil when it's used, or the boss won't wake.

steps.title: Scoria Ore
steps.how: Mine it in the lower Abyss (210% pickaxe); Chaotic Puffers and Devil Fish drop it after Golem.

steps.title: Scoria Bars
steps.how: Smelt at an Adamantite/Titanium Forge from 4 Scoria Ore plus 1 Fragment of Inferno (pack addition).

steps.title: Hydrothermic Armor (Melee)
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Scoria Bars.

steps.title: Life Alloy
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from one Cryonic, Perennial and Scoria Bar plus an Absolute Bar (pack addition). Needed for the Electromagnetic Lure, Exotic Pheromones and Yharon's egg.

steps.title: Electromagnetic Lure
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from a Dissolving element, 15 elemental fragments, 15 elemental plating and 2 Life Alloy (pack addition). Use on the surface Hallow to call a Chaos Construct, whose spirit becomes Lux; consumed. Bereft: someone nearby must carry Ravager Sigil when it's used, or the boss won't wake.

steps.title: Fragments of Chaos
steps.how: Any enemy in the Hallow has a 1/35 chance to drop 1-2. Used for Phase Bars and Astral Bars (pack addition).

steps.title: Phase Ore
steps.how: Lux drops a large amount (120-180 in its bag); Phase Assaulters and Speeders drop some too.

steps.title: Phase Bars
steps.how: Smelt 3 at an Adamantite/Titanium Forge from 30 Phase Ore, 5 Crystal Shards, 1 Fragment of Chaos and 2 Essence of Sunlight (pack addition).

steps.title: Elemental Armor
steps.how: Upgrade Twilight Assassin armor at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil with Phase Bars, Fragments of Chaos and Scoria Bars (4 / 6 / 5, pack addition); the breastplate also needs a Blink Pack or Particle Relocator.

steps.title: Decryption Computer
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from 18 Mysterious Circuitry, 10 Dubious Plating, Wire, Copper Bars and Glass after reading the Sunken Sea lab schematic. Decrypts the lab schematics that unlock Arsenal recipes.

steps.title: Astral Chunk
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 8 Dubious Plating, 20 Fallen Stars, 30 Starblight Soot and 6 Fragments of Otherworld (pack addition); requires the decrypted Planetoid (Tier 2) schematic. Use at night in the Astral Infection. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Leviathan Sigil.

steps.title: Aureus Cells
steps.how: Dropped by Astrum Aureus. Used for the reusable Starcore.

steps.title: Leviathan Ambergris
steps.how: Found in the Leviathan and Anahita Treasure Bag (Expert/Master only).

steps.title: Truffle Worm
steps.how: Catch one with a bug net in an underground Glowing Mushroom biome in Hardmode; use it as bait in the Ocean.

steps.title: Prismatic Lacewing
steps.how: Catch one with a bug net in the surface Hallow at night after Plantera, then release or kill it there. Bereft: someone nearby must carry Duke Fishron Sigil when it's used, or the boss won't wake.

steps.title: Plague Cell Canisters
steps.how: Dropped by Plague enemies (Plague Chargers, Melters, Viruling, etc.), which roam the Jungle after Golem.

steps.title: Abombination
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 20 Plague Cell Canisters and 12 Mysterious Circuitry; requires the decrypted Jungle lab (Tier 3) schematic. Use in the Jungle. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Golem Sigil.

steps.title: Plaguebringer Armor (Summoner)
steps.how: Upgrade Bee armor at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil with Alchemical Decanters, Infected Armor Plating (from the Plaguebringer Goliath) and Plague Cell Canisters.

steps.title: Plague Reaper Armor (Ranged)
steps.how: Upgrade Necro armor at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil with Plague Cell Canisters and Nanites.

steps.title: Death Whistle
steps.how: Craft at a Demon/Crimson Altar from 15 Lunar Tablet Fragments and 25 Lihzahrd Bricks. Reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Empress of Light Sigil.

steps.title: Ancient Manipulator
steps.how: Dropped by the Lunatic Cultist. Needed for Astral Bars, Astral armor, the Starcore and all lunar-tier gear.

steps.title: Meld Blobs
steps.how: Astrum Deus drops 16-24 Meld Blobs (20-32 in Expert).

steps.title: Titan Heart
steps.how: Dropped by Atlas in the Astral Infection. Place it in the Astral Beacon to summon Astrum Deus; the heart is consumed. Bereft: someone nearby must carry Lunatic Cultist Sigil when it's used, or the boss won't wake.

steps.title: Astral Ore
steps.how: Astral Ore can only be mined (210% pickaxe) after Astrum Deus dies; Astral Slimes also drop it from then on.

steps.title: Astral Bars
steps.how: Craft at an Ancient Manipulator from 2 Astral Ore, 3 Starblight Soot and 1 Fragment of Chaos (pack addition).

steps.title: Astral Armor
steps.how: Craft at an Ancient Manipulator from Astral Bars (12 / 24 / 18) plus Phase Bars (3 / 6 / 4, pack addition).

steps.title: Starcore
steps.how: Reusable Astrum Deus summon for rematches: craft at an Ancient Manipulator from 8 Astral Bars, 8 Aureus Cells, 25 Starblight Soot and 3 Phase Bars (pack addition). Astral Bars are only obtainable after Deus, so the first fight uses a Titan Heart.

steps.title: Titan Heart Armor (Rogue)
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from Astral Monoliths and a Titan Heart per piece.

steps.title: Torch Bombs
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from a Bomb, a Torch and a Glow Nylon; the Glowmoth also drops 8-16 (12-24 from its Silk Cocoon).

steps.title: Catalyst Bomb
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 5 Torch Bombs, a Dynamite, an Ectoplasm, a Soul of Night and 4 Meld Blobs (pack addition). Detonate it in the Sanctuary at Underworld depth; consumed. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Astrum Deus Sigil.

steps.title: Sanguite Bars
steps.how: The Subspace Serpent drops 16-29; afterwards any enemy has a 1/35 chance to drop 4-5. The Profaned Shard needs 4 (pack addition).

steps.title: Voidspace Armor
steps.how: Upgrade Vespera armor at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil with Sanguite Bars, Fragments of Inferno and Astral Bars (4 / 6 / 5, pack addition).

steps.title: Sigil Truffle Worm
steps.how: Craft from a Truffle Worm and a Plaguebringer Sigil. Fish with it in the Ocean to summon Duke Fishron; until he's beaten, a plain Truffle Worm is just bait.

steps.title: Luminite Bars
steps.how: Smelt Luminite (dropped by the Moon Lord) at an Ancient Manipulator.

steps.title: Unholy Essence
steps.how: After the Moon Lord, Impious Immolators and Scorn Eaters (Underworld/Hallow) and Profaned Energy drop it.

steps.title: Profaned Shard
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 5 Luminite Bars, 25 Unholy Essence and 4 Sanguite Bars (pack addition; from the Subspace Serpent). Use in the Hallow or Underworld; reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Moon Lord Sigil.

steps.title: Profaned Core
steps.how: Dropped by the Profaned Guardian Commander. Summons Providence (reusable). Bereft: someone nearby must carry Dragonfolly Sigil when it's used, or the boss won't wake.

steps.title: Divine Geodes
steps.how: Dropped by Providence (and the Profaned Guardians).

steps.title: Uelibloom Ore
steps.how: Providence's first kill seeds Uelibloom Ore in Jungle mud (225% pickaxe); Bloom Slimes drop it too.

steps.title: Uelibloom Bars
steps.how: Smelt at an Adamantite/Titanium Forge from 4 Uelibloom Ore.

steps.title: Tarragon Armor (Melee)
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Uelibloom Bars and Divine Geodes.

steps.title: Solar Fragments
steps.how: Left over from the Solar Pillar (or farm more there before the Moon Lord). Exotic Pheromones need 20 and the Mark of Providence 5.

steps.title: Exotic Pheromones
steps.how: Craft at an Ancient Manipulator from 5 Life Alloy and 20 Solar Fragments. Use in the Jungle; reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Profaned Guardian Sigil.

steps.title: Effulgent Feathers
steps.how: Dropped by the Dragonfolly (and Wild Bumblebirbs). Yharon's egg needs 15.

steps.title: Exodium Clusters
steps.how: Mine Exodium on the Luminite planetoids in space (225% pickaxe). The Cosmic Anvil needs 20.

steps.title: Necroplasm
steps.how: After the Moon Lord, killing strong Dungeon enemies can release Phantom Spirits, which drop Necroplasm.

steps.title: Necroplasmic Beacon
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 25 Wood and 50 Necroplasm. Use in the Dungeon; reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Storm Weaver Sigil and Ceaseless Void Sigil and Signus Sigil.

steps.title: Ruinous Souls
steps.how: Dropped by the Polterghast.

steps.title: Bloodflare Armor (Ranged)
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Bloodstone (Brimstone Crag enemies), Blood Orbs and Ruinous Souls.

steps.title: Bloodworm
steps.how: After the Moon Lord, Bloodworms appear in the Sulphurous Sea when no Acid Rain is active; catch one with a bug net and use it as bait there to fish up the Old Duke (consumed).

steps.title: Mark of Providence
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 3 Luminite Bars, 40 Unholy Essence and 5 Solar Fragments. Use in the Dungeon (Ceaseless Void), Underworld (Signus) or Space (Storm Weaver); reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Providence Sigil.

steps.title: Dark Plasma
steps.how: Dropped by the Ceaseless Void.

steps.title: Armored Shell
steps.how: Dropped by the Storm Weaver.

steps.title: Twisting Nether
steps.how: Dropped by Signus.

steps.title: Cosmic Worm
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from an Armored Shell, a Twisting Nether and a Dark Plasma (an alternate recipe uses 40 Luminite Bars, 10 of each lunar fragment, 10 Meld Blobs and 40 Necroplasm). Reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Old Duke Sigil.

steps.title: Prismatic Armor (Magic)
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Armored Shells, Exodium Clusters, Divine Geodes and Nanites.

steps.title: Empyrean Armor (Rogue)
steps.how: Craft at an Ancient Manipulator from Meld Blobs and Luminite Bars, plus 3 / 6 / 4 Sanguite Bars (pack addition).

steps.title: Solar Flare Armor (Melee)
steps.how: Craft at an Ancient Manipulator from Solar Fragments and Luminite Bars.

steps.title: Vortex Armor (Ranged)
steps.how: Craft at an Ancient Manipulator from Vortex Fragments and Luminite Bars.

steps.title: Nebula Armor (Magic)
steps.how: Craft at an Ancient Manipulator from Nebula Fragments and Luminite Bars.

steps.title: Stardust Armor (Summoner)
steps.how: Craft at an Ancient Manipulator from Stardust Fragments and Luminite Bars.

steps.title: Sigil Bloodworm
steps.how: Craft from a Bloodworm and a Polterghast Sigil. Fish with it in the Sulphurous Sea to summon the Old Duke; until he's beaten, plain Bloodworms and Acid Rain won't bring him.

steps.title: Cosmilite Bars
steps.how: Dropped by the Devourer of Gods.

steps.title: Cosmic Anvil
steps.how: Craft at an Ancient Manipulator from a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil, 10 Cosmilite Bars, 10 Luminite Bars and 20 Exodium Clusters. Crafts God Slayer, Silva and Auric gear.

steps.title: Nightmare Fuel
steps.how: Pumpkin Moon enemies drop it after the Devourer of Gods.

steps.title: Endothermic Energy
steps.how: Frost Moon enemies drop it after the Devourer of Gods. The Auric Quantum Cooling Cell needs 40.

steps.title: Darksun Fragments
steps.how: Solar Eclipse enemies drop them after the Devourer of Gods.

steps.title: Ascendant Spirit Essence
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 2 Necroplasm, 5 Nightmare Fuel, 5 Endothermic Energy and 2 Darksun Fragments.

steps.title: God Slayer Armor (Melee)
steps.how: Craft at the Cosmic Anvil from Cosmilite Bars and Ascendant Spirit Essence.

steps.title: Silva Armor (Summoner)
steps.how: Craft at the Cosmic Anvil from Planty Mush, Effulgent Feathers and Ascendant Spirit Essence.

steps.title: Fearmonger Armor (Summoner)
steps.how: Upgrade Spooky armor at the Cosmic Anvil with Cosmilite Bars, Ascendant Spirit Essence and Souls of Fright.

steps.title: Elemental Gauntlet
steps.how: Craft at the Cosmic Anvil from a Fire Gauntlet, 4 Ascendant Spirit Essence and 6 Sanguite Bars (pack addition).

steps.title: Jungle Dragon Egg
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 10 Life Alloy and 15 Effulgent Feathers (from the Dragonfolly). Use in the Jungle; reusable. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Devourer of Gods Sigil.

steps.title: Yharon Soul Fragments
steps.how: Dropped by Yharon.

steps.title: Auric Ore
steps.how: Yharon's first kill seeds Auric Ore underground (250% pickaxe); you can also shimmer a Yharon Soul Fragment into 10 Auric Ore.

steps.title: Auric Bars
steps.how: Smelt 5 at an Adamantite/Titanium Forge from 50 Auric Ore and 1 Yharon Soul Fragment. Needed for the Codebreaker's cooling cell.

steps.title: Auric Tesla Armor (Melee)
steps.how: Fuse God Slayer (or Silva), Bloodflare and Tarragon pieces with Auric Bars at the Cosmic Anvil.

steps.title: Codebreaker Base
steps.how: Craft at an Anvil from a Charging Station, 20 Mysterious Circuitry and 35 Dubious Plating; fit it with the Decryption Computer and the other Codebreaker parts.

steps.title: Voltage Regulation System
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 10 Mysterious Circuitry, 10 Dubious Plating, 10 Uelibloom Bars and 10 Luminite Bars; requires the Underworld lab (Tier 4) schematic.

steps.title: Auric Quantum Cooling Cell
steps.how: Craft at the Cosmic Anvil from 5 Auric Bars, 8 Mysterious Circuitry, 8 Dubious Plating, 40 Endothermic Energy and 6 Essence of Eleum; requires the Ice lab (Tier 5) schematic. Insert it in the Codebreaker to contact Draedon. Bereft: the recipe also needs 1 Supreme Calamitas Sigil.

steps.title: Altar of the Accursed
steps.how: Craft at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from 30 Brimstone Slag, 5 Auric Bars and a Core of Calamity; places a Supreme Calamitas altar if you need one away from the Brimstone Crags.

steps.title: Ashes of Calamity (Offering)
steps.how: Hold Ashes of Calamity (from the Calamitas Clone) and right-click the altar in the Brimstone Crags; one is consumed per summon. Bereft: someone nearby must carry Yharon Sigil when it's used, or the boss won't wake.

steps.title: Ashes of Annihilation
steps.how: Dropped by Supreme Calamitas.

steps.title: Ceremonial Urn
steps.how: Craft at the altar from 5 Ashes of Annihilation and 15 Ashes of Calamity; lets you re-summon Supreme Calamitas without consuming Ashes.

steps.title: Exo Prisms
steps.how: Dropped by the Exo Mechs.

steps.title: Draedon's Forge
steps.how: Combine a Cosmic Anvil, an Adamantite/Titanium Forge, a Tinkerer's Workshop and an Ancient Manipulator with 15 Auric Bars, 12 Exo Prisms and 15 Ascendant Spirit Essence.

steps.title: Shadowspec Bars
steps.how: Craft at Draedon's Forge from one Auric Bar, Exo Prism and Ash of Annihilation each.

steps.title: Demonshade Armor (Summoner)
steps.how: Craft at Draedon's Forge from Shadowspec Bars.
